$comment: Authoritative LGD Assembly Constituency register. FK to lgd_states.json on lgd_state_id and lgd_pcs.json on lgd_pc_id. Sourced from datasets/taxonomy/lgd/constituency-report-2026-06-01.xlsx. KNOWN GAPS: state_code=7 Delhi (0 ACs; expected 70) - the source report excluded Delhi. UTs without legislatures (A&N=35, Chandigarh=4, DNHDD=38, Lakshadweep=31, Ladakh=37) correctly have 0 ACs. Total in this snapshot: 3918 ACs; expected ~4123. ECI ac_no is NOT carried here (LGD report has no ECI mapping); the ECI -> LGD AC join lives in datasets/taxonomy/ac_crosswalk.parquet per ADR-0049. Builder: tools/migrate/build_lgd_acs_pcs.py.
